chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Naming his brothers and sisters
summary: JCH and Mrs. H list the brothers and sisters in birth order, including Garnett, father of Irene Higginbotham.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Could you name your other brothers?
I sure can. I was the youngest and the oldest -
You're the youngest.
I know I'm the youngest.
I can name all his brothers. Bud is next to you.
He's got one living brother.
His name is Marion. They call him Bud. That's the next one. The next one, Eutris Kent.
That's your sister.
Yeah.
He don't want your sisters; he wants your brothers.
Oh, you want the brothers. Walter.
There was one named Charles. They all dead.
And Garnett.
Seven brothers. Garnett. Yeah, he's the one teaching the school.
That's Irene Higginbotham's father, the one that wrote music for Billie Holiday.
So now you want to get to the sisters. Eutris, E-u-t-r-i-s. That's the youngest.
Who are the others?
Darned if I know.
There's Anna May.
Got Sonia.
There's Emma, there's Pauline. There's one that died about 3/4 years ago. What was the one that died?
Artrina.
Artina?
Yeah, Artrina.
Artrina, beautiful name.
You had seven sisters?
Six. There's another one - Stella. That's all.
To put them in order, who was born first?
Pauline is the oldest and then Emma, then Annie May, then Stella - well, the one that died, I don't know - she must have been between - she was before Stella, and Eutris is the baby.
What I'm trying to get was like, who was born first?
I just gave it. I can't tell you about the boys.
I got scrapbooks back there that would take you a year to read.
Who was oldest, Garnett or Charles?
Mm - Charles.
Charles, Walter, then Garnett, Marion. Bud is behind Jay.
Oh, I forgot about him.
Jay is the baby.
We're missing one brother.
